title: Complete overarching core audit through its answered questions and corrected allegations
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete chronological overarching design audit and later self-corrections
reviews.disposition:
The complete1,105line audit includes all OD1–OD25register rows, six PLdrafts, C1–C11conflicts, J1–J4/S1–S5stress findings, U1–U7handoffs, thirteen RDrows and every later discussion/correction through reciprocal loops and the final rule reconciliation. The original no-spine/eight-open-core headline is superseded within the same file by the direction summary and answered broad questions. PL1–PL6remain proposed syntheses: quote sourcing alone does not adopt every added qualifier, such as PL1's claim that only crossing/conversion/saves are global. Actual world/means and existing shared mechanics govern. OD8separates truth/knowledge/views without mandating one monolithic database or current consolidation. Historical fragmentation counts/197place-literal files/22proposalstrings/1,006unread are dated inspections, not a fresh current-code audit. J4inferred no playable next-life route is qualified by RF3's own partial heir implementation; no natural world-jump/prestige/week-return was exercised then.

The discussion explicitly revises earlier defaults: one person need not mean one body or mandatory death; remembered/base-cheat carryover does not ban retained raw power; guided/full-random/specific entry does not require Village-first; danger and forgiving recovery differ, and a local trap need not be universally escapable. Means-based world return, fresh/parallel histories, intentional loops, body/self/knowledge continuity and actual soul-bound duties remain distinct. A commerce-oriented cheat was incorrectly paraphrased as selling the cheat itself; later OD11/EC4correction preserves the old interpretation as history without prohibiting transfer powers elsewhere. Ordinary offline routines advance current-world time, choice stops halt linked deadlines/production unless actual supported means permit more, and journey time-bank scope is answered broadly without universal cap/rate or free compounded production. Comfort remains freely changeable while prospective modes and real in-world powers differ. Actual cause-driven threats/fate can restore canon or adapt; automatic plot rescue and forced equal scaling are not inferred. Superior knowledge/forecasting can be exact through means; failed experiments are not guaranteed XP.

C10is an important correction to the audit itself: its initial missing-authority allegation does not invalidate the recorded October9storyteller/cruelty answer. The file later retracts that reading and preserves the conditional-format-Q1 distinction. Likewise CA1–CA13, the fresh-life Q1, CA14unconscious access and reciprocal-return answers supersede earlier open sections; do not restart an interview from their chronological next-question sentences. CR/ER/WC/IC/RC/SC/BX/BT/NRimplications, proposed schemas,83serializer-root coverage, ARactivation/walkthrough cases and automatic terminal rules remain scoped proposals/source observations rather than adopted runtime contracts. Native unconsciousness and actual true death should be described by the real route rather than the legacy total_deaths field name.

Current scope follows [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), the [rules index](RULES_INDEX.md), [direction summary](DIRECTION_SUMMARY.md) and actual task owners. The old one-realm/prestige milestone is retired by the October24direction; AD42makes human review optional and AD51allows the first useful shared seam without requiring a second-world permission gate. Historical1366evidence is not current UI_RULESdesktop proof. Old created-chat IDs, exclusive write grants, model recommendations, rerun triggers and CP1–CP7assignments are dated history, not current live locks, automatic audit/worker dispatch or commit authority. The M1–M9method remains useful when selected for a named uncertainty; source/table/screenshot claims and external links retain original verification scope. Nothing here changes a rulebook, gameplay, saved history, source qualification, product priority or present verification state.
reviews.evidence: Actual complete bounded reading of lines1–1105, including every table and late answers/retractions. Relevant live direction-summary sections were inspected in B431; no new USER_VISION whole-file, source/code, browser, private pack, threads or runtime audit.
reviews.reopen: Use exact latest user authority and actual selected owner; preserve proposals/history and do not reuse initial contradictions/fragmentation counts as current findings or reopen answered questions.
